Shackle Undead is a priest class talent. It shackles an undead enemy, making it unable to move or attack for the duration of the spell, and visibly enclosing the creature within chains.

.]] Shades are disembodied spirits that are similar to ghosts in that they are the spectral remains of a once-living person. These often restless spirits are mostly found in the Plaguelands, other undead-infested areas, and the village surrounding the mysterious tower of Karazhan. Because they do not have a real body, some shades are immune to physical damage. Shades who were created intentionally, as opposed to forming out of happenstance, were called forth from the depths of the sacrificial pits after the sacrifice of voluntary acolytes of the Cult of the Damned. These shades are vile, wraith-like creatures who exist only to serve their dark lord, the Lich King. The invisible shades are vi

The Shade of Elura is a night elf ghost located in the sea near Auberdine in Darkshore. Once the captain of a ship, now cursed to roam the deeps and protect her shipment of Elunite Ore for all time. Elanaria would like Elura's Medallion.
Shackles of the Unscarred is cloth wrist armor useful in PvP.
Shade of Eranikus is an elite ghostly dragon boss found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. In order to fight Eranikus, you must first defeat Jammal'an the Prophet.
Sewage Slimes are oozelings found at the Construct Quarter in Naxxramas.
Shadikith the Glider is a named elite bat in the Servants' Quarters in Karazhan. It is one of three bosses that can spawn after clearing most of the trash in the area.

__NOTOC__ Sha'ni Proudtusk is a quest giver located atop Dreadmaul Rock in the Burning Steppes. She was the ghost of a dead jungle troll whose remains lay on an altar there. Krom'Grul tortured and killed Sha'ni, and stole her wedding nose-ring. Her husband was Thal'trak Proudtusk who she planned to live with in the Hinterlands after her last mission was done. She has been missing since the Cataclysm, presumably have finally found the peace of death.

The Sha'naari Wastes are widestretched plains located south of Fallen Sky Ridge. The Ruins of Sha'naar lie in its southern nook, and the Cenarion Post is located behind a small tor by the road in the northern part of the wastes.
The Sha'tari Base Camp is an encampment defended by Sha'tar vindicators. It is located southwest of Auchindoun in Terokkar Forest's Bone Wastes.
Sextant of Unstable Currents is an epic trinket for DPS casters.
Severin is a human quest giver located at Blackwind Landing in Terokkar Forest.
The Shabby Arakkoa Disguise turns the wearer into an arakkoa. While in disguise, speak with Sahaak at Terokk's Rest to be able to purchase the book Adversarial Bloodlines.
Sha'tari Anchorite's Cloak is a quest reward from How to Break Into the Arcatraz.
Shadesteel Girdle is crafted with Blacksmithing (375); taught by Plans: Shadesteel Girdle, an Ashtongue Deathsworn reputation reward.

Shackle Key drops from Hitah'ya the Keeper in the Hinterlands.
Sha'naar Key is contained in the Metal Coffer in Hellfire Peninsula. This item is provided for The Dreghood Elders.
The Shadethicket Oracle was a bog beast located in Fallen Sky Lake in Ashenvale.
The Shade of Hakkar could be found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. It was the Avatar of Hakkar's spectral form, visible while dousing the flames to summon the avatar in its true form.
Sha'tar Vindicators are draenei found in Terokkar Forest, fighting against the Auchenai.
The Sha'tari Torch is provided as an objective for An Improper Burial.
Sha'ni's Nose-Ring drops from Krom'Grul in the Burning Steppes.

__NOTOC__ Sewer Carp are fished from the waters of the Underbelly in Dalaran. It can also, but rarely, be fished up from the Dalaran fountain.
The Shackles of Perpetual Friendship were a quest reward from WANTED: Ragemane's Flipper during the Wrath of the Lich King beta. However, the quest rewards was changed before retail.
Shade of Taerar is summoned in groups of three by Taerar at 75%, 50%, and 25% health. When they are summoned Taerar remains unattackable for a certan amount of time or until all three are defeated.
Shades of Mal'druk are summoned by Mal'druk the Soulrender if attacked. He resides in the cave under Ango'rosh Stronghold in Zangarmarsh.
Sevren's Orders were provided as an objective for The Prodigal Lich and The Prodigal Lich (2).

Shadebough is a small camp located northeast of the Writhing Deep in the Lower Wilds of Feralas and under the leadership of Adella. It is worth noting that unlike other Alliance camps this one forces you to ride through gnoll infested lands to reach the camp.
Shadethicket Wood Shapers are bog beasts that can be found in the Ruins of Stardust in Ashenvale.
Shadethicket Stone Movers are bog beasts found near the rivers of eastern Ashenvale.
Shadethicket Raincallers are bog beasts found in the Ruins of Stardust in Ashenvale.
Shadethicket Bark Rippers are bog beasts found near the rivers of eastern Ashenvale.
Shackles of Punishment were a quest reward from School's Out Forever (quest).
Shaabad is an Alliance draenei shaman with a chance to appear in the Trial of the Crusader against the Horde.
The Sha of Doubt is one of the seven prime sha after Anger, Despair, Fear, Hatred, and Violence and mostly tries to take over the Jade Forest, especially over the temple.

The Sha of Violence is one of the sha primes sealed away by Emperor Shaohao beneath the Shado-Pan Monastery along the Sha of Hatred and Sha of Anger. Unlike the other two, it was unable to escape the monastery before being slain.

The Sha of Fear is one of seven prime sha. It was sealed by Emperor Shaohao in ancient times. The sha primes were freed by the Alliance-Horde war arriving in Pandaria. The Sha of Fear escaped its prison in Niuzao Temple and proceeded to corrupt the Mantid of the Dread Wastes. After Klaxxi-aligned adventurers killed Grand Empress Shek'zeer, the Sha prime retreated to the Terrace of Endless Spring. The Sha of Fear is the fourth and final boss of the Terrace of Endless Spring as well as the end encounter for Tier 14. During the fight, the raid group will periodically be forced apart to battle both the Sha of Fear and its Terror Spawn adds, and the Shadows of the Golden Lotus. On heroic, the rai
Sha-Haunted Tigresses are tigers located at Krasarang River in the Krasarang Wilds.

Shado-Master Chong is a pandaren located in Shado-Pan Fallback in Kun-Lai Summit. Having sent a request for reinforcements from the Shado-Pan Monastery, he led the defense of Firebough Nook against the sha and yaungol, but lost it and had to evacuate. He created the Blinding Rage Trap from Blind Rage Essences to be used against Kobai.
Shado-Pan Guards are pandaren located at Shado-Pan Fallback in Kun-Lai Summit.

Sha of Anger is one of the seven prime sha, and a world boss found in Kun-Lai Summit. It drops Arena season 12 rewards and tier 14 set items. It took a raid of roughly 40 level 85 players to take down the Sha of Anger. The sha originally appeared in one of five possible areas of the zone, each spawn point coming with its own minions surrounding it. As of Patch 7.2.0, it only spawns at the Burlap Trail point. His respawn timer is random and varies from kill to kill between 10 and 20 minutes unlike other Pandaria World Bosses' typical 15 Minute Spawn Timers.
Shado-Pan Gatewatchers are pandaren located at Winter's Blossom in Kun-Lai Summit.

Shado-Master Zhiyao was a pandaren who gave his live against a yaungol attack at Shado-Li Basin in Kun-Lai Summit. Ban Bearheart would send an adventurer to give Zhiyao his final rites. Finally free, the pandaren's soul floats away into the sky.
Shado-Pan Monastery Guards are pandaren located at Shado-Pan Monastery in Kun-Lai Summit.
The Shado-Pan Sentinel is a pandaren located at Shado-Pan Monastery in Kun-Lai Summit.
The Shado-Pan Caravan is a caravan located at Longying Outpost in Townlong Steppes.
Shado-Pan Hawks are hawks accompanying Farwatch Hawkmasters at Farwatch Overlook in Townlong Steppes.
Sha of Hatred is the primary antagonist of the Shado-Pan quest chain in Townlong Steppes.

Shado-Pan Fallback is the tower serving as the corner of the Serpent's Spine in southwest Kun-Lai Summit, where it turns south after traveling southwest along the border with Townlong Steppes. Immediately outside the northern door of the tower is Firebough Nook, which has been infested by the sha. has been requesting reinforcements from the Shado-Pan Monastery, far to the north, but they have not been forthcoming.

The Shado-Li Basin runs from the Kota Basecamp northwest to Winter's Blossom and down the path toward the Ox Gate of the Serpent's Spine in western Kun-Lai Summit, nestled between Kota Peak and Mount Neverest.
The Shade of Ling Heartfist is a pandaren ghost that been corrupted by an ancient evil of darkness. It is the master of the Tortured Souls. The ghost disappears when defeated.
Sha-Haunted Rodents are beavers located at the Horrid March in the Dread Wastes.
The Shade of Shadumbra is the essence of Shadumbra which can become one with an alliance players during the quest Defend the Tree!.
Shado-Pan Bandages are provided by Sun Tenderheart for the Golden Lotus daily quest Given a Second Chance.
A Shado-Pan Torch is provided by Anji Autumnlight for the Golden Lotus daily quest Burning Away the Filth.
The Shado-Pan Dragon Gun is a dragon gun rewarded to adventurers by the Shado-Pan of Pandaria.
Shado-Pan Tabard is a Shado-Pan reputation reward, sold for from at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes. It requires reputation to purchase.
Shado-Pan Blackguards are pandaren found fending off Shan'ze Invaders storming the Shado-Pan Garrison-Niuzao Temple bridge in Townlong Steppes.
Sha-Skin Regalia is the tier 14 warlock set. As the name suggests, it's modeled after the Sha.

Sha-Touched gems are items that fit exclusively in Sha-Touched sockets, much in the manner of cut gems. Currently the only items having Sha-Touched sockets are from Grand Empress Shek'zeer in Heart of Fear, and Tsulong, Lei Shi and Sha of Fear in Terrace of Endless Spring. Sha-Touched gems are unique-equipped. Wrathion also provides a prismatic socket upgrade for any Sha-Touched weapons in Patch 5.1 via the Eye of the Black Prince.
Sha Haunts are sha found at Garrosh'ar Point and Thunder Hold in the Jade Forest. They affected local soldiers.
Sha Harbingers are sha summoned by the people's negative emotions at Garrosh'ar Point and Thunder Hold in the Jade Forest.

Permanently increase the Stamina of an item worn on the chest, shoulders, legs, hands or feet by 9. Attaching causes the item to become soulbound. Armor kits fill the same virtual "slot" as enchantments and will overwrite any existing enchantments, or be overwritten by enchantments applied later.

Sha-Touched Herbs are mysterious Sha infected herb nodes found in the Sha-covered areas of Valley of the Four Winds, Dread Wastes and Kun-Lai Summit in Pandaria. They may be harvested with Herbalism (575). These are similar to the Frozen Herbs of Northrend.
__NOTOC__ Sha Crystals are obtained by disenchanting items added in patch 5.0.4 not purchased with Justice Points. They can also be obtained by combining 5x Sha Crystal Fragment.

Sha of Happiness is a novelty account of the grim Sha primes (Anger, Doubt, Fear, Hatred, Pride, Violence), inspired by Doulie on Illidan US on October 20, 2012. Rygarius attempted to calm down the thread, but was soon overtaken by the Sha's influence. As of October 29, the initial thread has reached 87 pages, has a Twitter account, and has been covered by websites such as WoW Insider. Remember to stay strong, and not be taken over by the influence of this vile... {◕ ◡ ◕}
Sha-Touched Leather can be skinned off of beasts on Pandaria.
Sha-Touched Claw is looted from the Korune Spellweaver at Mogujia in southeastern Kun-Lai Summit.

The Shado-Pan Assault (also spelled Shado-pan Assault) are the elite Shado-Pan forces sent to kill Lei Shen, the Thunder King, once and for all. Lord Taran Zhu leads the planning of the attack from a cave underneath the Conqueror's Terrace. The main way of gaining reputation with the assault is killing bosses in the Throne of Thunder raid. This gives access to impressive Valor reward items depending on the level of reputation.
Sha-Touched Leg Armor is crafted by Leatherworkers with a skill level of 545. This pattern is taught by Leatherworking trainers.
Sha of Anger Guild Run is an achievement that is awarded for defeating Sha of Anger in the Kun-Lai Summit in a raid with at least 8 guild members.

Shadewood Thicket lies between Shaol'mara / Violet Rise and the Diremoor on the eastern side of the mainland of the Isle of Thunder. After Violet Rise is established, the area is mostly taken over by the Alliance and Kirin Tor Perimeter Wards are put up.

Shado-Pan Monks are pandaren located in the Sealed Chambers in the Shado-Pan Monastery. They are fighting the Sha of Violence.

Shado-Pan Disciples are pandaren located outside Cloudstrike Dojo in the Shado-Pan Monastery. After being defeated, they turn .
Shado-Pan Stormbringers are pandaren located in Cloudstrike Dojo in the Shado-Pan Monastery.
Sha Manifestations are sha during the Sha of Violence encounter in the Sealed Chambers in the Shado-Pan Monastery.
Shado-Master Chum Kiu is a pandaren quest giver in Siege of Niuzao Temple.
__NOTOC__ Shade of the Spiritspeaker is an arcane wraith located at Lake Kel'Theril in Winterspring.

The Sewer Access Point is the sewer tunnel which leads from the Grand Courtyard into the Halls of Flesh-Shaping, where the Dark Animus is being stored. Flesh'rok the Diseased, a diseased saurok, somewhat similar to Primordius in appearance can be found here during the quest Something Foul is Afoot.
Sezik Steampot is a level 90 goblin chef found at the entrance to his establishment, the Boiling Crustacean, on Bilgewater Beach of Krasarang Wilds.

__NOTOC__ Shado-Pan Reliquary Kilt drops from Spoils of Pandaria in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Sha-Infused Defenders are pandaren found at Scarred Vale of Siege of Orgrimmar.

The Shado-Pan Geyser Gun is a lesser known item acquired by a very unusual means while in the Throne of Thunder. To acquire the item players need to use the geysers in the Lair of Tortos and bounce from geyser to geyser in a circle 250 times. Each geyser has its own cooldown, so bouncing back and forth will not work. At level 91 or above, speak with Lorewalker Han at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms to queue for the Forgotten Depths of the Throne of Thunder in Raid Finder mode. Players will spawn in the area with the geysers.

Shado-Pan Defender appears inside an instanced version of Thunder Forges for the quest The Thunder Forge (quest). He is treated as a member of the player's party and will defend the player against the mogu that attempt to interfere with the charging of the Thunder Forge.
Severmaw is a boar located at the Daggermaw Ravine in Frostfire Ridge.
Shadeback Ravagers are ravagers located in Shadowglade in Spires of Arak.
The Sha'tari Defender's Medallion is a toy that, upon use, transforms the player into a draenei Sha'tari Defender for one hour.
The Sha'tari Defense fights back the Burning Legion's invasion of Shattrath.
The Sha'tari Anchorage is the main harbor of , along the coast of the . During the Battle for Shattrath, Khadgar leads Alliance and Horde forces against the Iron Horde forces under in the harbor.
Sha'tar Way Station is a section on the western side of in Talador where many travelers enter to stable their elekks or fey dragons.
The Sha'tari Rest and Recovery is a building in the Shattrath Residential District of . Many Injured Sha'tari Citizens and Sha'tari Field Medics are found inside prior to the battle.
Sha'naari Refuge is a small camp located north of Temple of Sha'naar in Tanaan Jungle.
Shaadum is a wrathguard located at the Congregation of Souls in .
Shade Plagueheart is a forsaken follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Shade of Xavius is a shade of Xavius, the Nightmare Lord, and is the final boss located at the Heart of Dread in Darkheart Thicket.
The Sha'tari Keeper Legguards are a quest reward from Not In Your House and Send Them Running.
The Sha'tari Keeper Shoulders are a quest reward from Pieces of Us.
Severer of Souls are found during Gara'jal's encounter in Mogu'shan Vaults.
Shackle's Den is a small camp controlled by Mr. Shackle just north of the Temple of a Thousand Lights in Azsuna.
Sew It Begins opens up 800 maximum skill for Tailoring and starts the profession's questlines in Legion.

The Shadelight Truffles can be found in the Skyrange of the Valley of the Four Winds. They can also be looted from a Shadelight Spore-Cluster after some time when it grows into a Shadelight Truffle.
__NOTOC__ Sha-Infested Prowlers are tigers found in Honeydew Glade in Jade Forest. They are Wary Forest Prowlers transformed by the sha unleashed by the Horde and Alliance conflict.
Shado-Pan Marksmen are pandaren located on the Serpent's Spine.
__NOTOC__ The Shackled Ur'zul is a very rare drop from Argus the Unmaker, the final boss of Antorus, the Burning Throne, on Mythic difficulty.

Shademistresses are man'ari eredar found at the High Inquisitor's Lair of Krokuun.
